SV-11962.summary: Verify Technician Toggle A1: session-neutral Technician permission (Release A tech release)
SV-11962.note: Developer verification task for Release A of the ROLE version (PRD v9): a session-neutral Technician permission on roles, migrations, fe-permissions, "Role is not editable.". PRD v17 has no Technician setting on roles, so none of its checks applies. The user-visible behaviour it protects (no logout from a Technician change or the release) is covered by INV-11 and S6-26.

SV-11963.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B1: technician lists offer only technicians
SV-11963.note: Developer checklist for the lists (B1). Its setup ("turn Technician off on a test role such as Parts Manager") is the role version; under v17 the toggle is per staff member. Every check that still holds is covered by the Story 3 cases named here. Its line "Time sheets, the time sheet dialogs, Punch Clock Activities, Part Sale, Schedule ... still list them" names Part Sale, which PRD v17 S3-R6a says shows no technician dropdown.

SV-11964.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B2: Turn Off Technician warning
SV-11964.note: Developer checklist for the warning (B2), written for the role version: "Roles & Permissions → Edit a role", a people count and the role name, "Save continues to the Confirm Permission Updates window", and a count endpoint per role. PRD v17 warns per staff member in Edit Staff Member. The v17 checks are covered by the Story 2 cases named here.

SV-11965.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B3: Technician card in Roles & Permissions
SV-11965.note: Developer checklist for a Technician card in Roles & Permissions (B3): role version only (Cross-Cutting card, Confirm Permission Updates, View Permissions, Duplicate Role, Reset To Template). PRD v17 has no such card; INV-15 checks that Roles & Permissions gains no Technician permission. Its pill end-date item is covered by S1-05 and S4-10 (SV-12008).

SV-11966.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B4: staff list column, notice and Public API value
SV-11966.note: Developer checklist for the staff list column, notice and Public API value (B4). Its rule "Yes = active, role has Technician on, Time Clock on" is the role version; v17 reads the person's own toggle (S4-R1). Covered by the Story 4 and API cases named here.

SV-11967.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B5: release-day migration keeps every technician
SV-11967.note: Developer checklist for the release-day migration (B5), granting per ROLE ("a role with evidence is on whatever its name"); PRD v17 turns Technician on per staff member (S6-R1). The evidence rules that still match are covered by the Release day cases named here.

SV-11968.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B6a: "No technicians yet" text on Board View and Tech View
SV-11968.note: Developer checklist for the "No technicians yet" text (B6a). Its text "Turn Technician on for a role in Roles & Permissions to assign work orders. ..." is the v9 text; PRD v17 S3-R10 reads "Turn Technician on for your technicians in Staff to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.". The cases follow v17.

SV-11969.summary: Verify Technician Toggle B6b: "Set Up Technicians" button and first-run text
SV-11969.note: Developer checklist for "Set Up Technicians" and the first-run text (B6b). The cases follow v17.
